item.title: How to Claim Your Cut of Apple’s $250 Million Siri Settlement
item.description: Apple may pay out up to $95 for each eligible iPhone purchased by someone who felt misled about Siri’s release. You have until December 21 to submit a claim.

item.title: Rabbit Is Back, This Time With an AI Agent App
item.description: Two years after trying to sidestep mobile apps with dedicated AI hardware, Rabbit is launching OS3, a cross-platform agent that lives on the screens you already use.

item.title: Viture’s Vonder Glasses Are Meant to Map Your Mind
item.description: No cameras? No problem. Viture’s first display-free smart glasses have bone-conduction microphones to privately record your daily musings.

item.title: AI Models Built From Rat Brains Just Got Closer to Reality
item.description: The Biological Computing Company is bringing its AI tools to Amazon Web Services in a major boost for a once-fringe field that aims to marry nature with code.

item.title: I Built AI Clones of My Coworkers. Things Got Weird
item.description: Brian Bot loved talking about improv, while Sophie Bot wouldn’t stop calling me “big dog.” Welcome to the future of work.

item.title: Patti Harrison Had Dreams of a Tech Utopia. Silicon Valley Smashed Them
item.description: The comedian sat down with WIRED to talk about social media, AI, and getting laughs for impersonating Boston Dynamics’ robot dogs.

item.title: A New Tool Found Malware That’s Guided by an AI Hive Mind—No Humans in Sight
item.description: Cisco Talos researchers created a new framework for identifying malware and hacking tools that rely on AI chatbots—and quickly discovered something unusual.

item.title: A New Chatbot Wants to Unlock the Secrets in Tattered Ancient Greek Records
item.description: In the hope of uncovering new details about ancient life, researchers have developed a large language model that fills in the gaps in papyrus fragments.

item.title: How to Use AI With Your Privacy Intact
item.description: Your conversations with AI chatbots are both highly personal and deeply vulnerable to surveillance. Here’s how you can protect yourself.

item.title: AI, Tariffs, Rare Minerals: What to Expect From Trump’s Upcoming Summit With Xi Jinping
item.description: Washington and Beijing have grown ever more linked in the AI boom, making hardware exports and technological restrictions hefty bargaining chips in negotiations.
